notes: Structured query templates for the Facebook Insights (organic Page) report, built against the live Facebook Insights (fins) connector schema and validated clean against a live account. ORGANIC ONLY — no paid/spend metrics. Field IDs are raw. Dates NOT stored — runtime resolves from today's date; compare_to_previous queries run twice (current + matching previous window). FACEBOOK RULES (enforced by validate_query): (1) demographics (country, city) CANNOT combine with each other, nor with lifetime/post/video metric groups — each demographic is its own single-pivot query paired with a page_insights metric (e.g. page_posts_impressions_organic), NOT a lifetime metric like page_fan_count. (2) Page-insights, post-lifetime, and video-lifetime metric groups are separate report families — keep Page, Post, and Video/Reels as separate queries. DATA NOTES: lifetime metrics (page_followers_count/fan_count/talking_about/star_rating) are point-in-time snapshots; use page_daily_follows/page_daily_unfollows for period change. The connector exposes organic impressions (page_posts_impressions_organic), not a single unified reach figure. Shares are the highest-value (reach-expanding) interaction on Facebook.

queries.title: Page Insights Totals
queries.note: Period totals — KPI dashboard, growth/engagement headline, reaction sentiment mix. Run twice for period-over-period.

queries.title: Lifetime Snapshot
queries.note: Point-in-time current totals (followers, fans, talking-about, star rating). Snapshot, not a period sum.

queries.title: Weekly Growth & Engagement Trend
queries.note: Weekly trend for the growth/engagement chart. Use date for a daily line.

queries.title: Post Performance
queries.note: Per-post performance. post_status_type gives the format. Shares are the highest-value signal. Separate report family from page/video.

queries.title: Video / Reels Performance
queries.note: Video and Reels. blue_reels_play_count = Reels plays. Separate report family from page/post.

queries.title: Audience — Country
queries.pivot_rule: Single demographic pivot. Pair with a page_insights metric (organic impressions), NOT a lifetime metric. Cannot combine with city.

queries.title: Audience — City
queries.pivot_rule: Single demographic pivot. Cannot combine with country.
